statement: When a customer texts asking to move a booking, I want to answer with suitable free times in under 2 minutes, so I can keep my evening free.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'keep my evening free' in a usability session

statement: When the owner opens the message, the system shall ensure that a draft reply with up to 3 proposed slots from that tenant's calendar is shown within 5 seconds (precondition: a tenant has an inbound reschedule SMS and at least 3 free slots in the next 7 days).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 1 of AIOPS-STY-001 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given a tenant has an inbound reschedule SMS and at least 3 free slots in the next 7 days When the owner opens the message Then a draft reply with up to 3 proposed slots from that tenant's calendar is shown within 5 seconds

statement: When the owner has not tapped approve, the system shall ensure that 0 messages are sent and 0 bookings are created for that draft (precondition: a draft reply is shown).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 2 of AIOPS-STY-001 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given a draft reply is shown When the owner has not tapped approve Then 0 messages are sent and 0 bookings are created for that draft

statement: When I approve a proposed time, I want to book the slot and confirm it to the customer in one step, so I can avoid double handling.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'avoid double handling' in a usability session

statement: When the approval is submitted, the system shall ensure that a booking is created in that tenant's calendar and one confirmation message is queued within 10 seconds (precondition: an owner approves one proposed slot).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 1 of AIOPS-STY-002 (priority must)
acceptance_criteria: Given an owner approves one proposed slot When the approval is submitted Then a booking is created in that tenant's calendar and one confirmation message is queued within 10 seconds

statement: When the assistant suggests a message, I want to see where the suggestion came from, so I can trust what goes out in my name.
rationale: User need captured as a job story (priority should)
acceptance_criteria: Target users achieve the outcome 'trust what goes out in my name' in a usability session

statement: When the owner expands the sources, the system shall ensure that the inbound message and every calendar slot used (up to 3) are listed with their IDs within 2 seconds (precondition: a draft reply is shown).
rationale: Derived from acceptance scenario 1 of AIOPS-STY-003 (priority should)
acceptance_criteria: Given a draft reply is shown When the owner expands the sources Then the inbound message and every calendar slot used (up to 3) are listed with their IDs within 2 seconds
